title: Vikram and Betal: The Lazy Man

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a lazy man.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a lazy man who avoided work.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The man asks for a reward.
scenes.text: The lazy man claimed he worked hard and asked the king for a reward.
scenes.image_prompt: lazy man asking king for reward cartoon

scenes.text: Tenali gave the man a task to complete.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali giving task to lazy man cartoon

scenes.text: The man returned without completing the task.
scenes.image_prompt: lazy man standing empty handed cartoon

scenes.text: The king understood the truth and refused to reward him. Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king refusing reward while betal flies away cartoon

story: A lazy man tried to get a reward without working. Tenali tested him and proved he was lazy. The king refused to reward him. Vikram said only hard work deserves rewards, and Betal flew away.
